column3: NKJV has “It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “I must boast; it is not profitable.”
NKJV has “My strength,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “power.”
NKJV includes “in boasting,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
